                titulo: "The Three-Part Technical Address"
                puntos:
                  - "Introduction (15%): Hook the audience, define the research question, outline key takeaways."
                  - "Body (70%): Present methodology, experimental validation, and quantitative outcomes with clear signposts."
                  - "Conclusion (15%): Summarize contributions, state practical implications, propose future work."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "CEFR C1 • SIGNPOSTING DISCOURSE"
                titulo: "Navigational Markers for the Audience"
                puntos:
                  - "Transitioning: 'Turning now to our numerical findings...', 'Let us direct our attention to Table 2.'"
                  - "Digressing & Returning: 'To put this into context...', 'Returning to our central hypothesis...'"
                  - "Emphasizing: 'What is particularly noteworthy here is...', 'The pivotal takeaway is that...'"
                  - "Concluding: 'To recap our main findings...', 'In light of these outcomes, we recommend...'"
              - numero: 3
                seccion: "CEFR C1 • DATA COMMENTARY"
                titulo: "Verbalizing Graphical Trends"
                puntos:
                  - "Upward trends: 'plateaued', 'surged', 'experienced steady growth'."
                  - "Fluctuations: 'oscillated within a 5% band', 'exhibited periodic dips'."
                  - "Peaks and troughs: 'peaked at 480 MW', 'bottomed out at zero'."
                  - "Example: 'As illustrated in the contour plot, thermal stress peaks at the blade root.'"
              - numero: 4
                seccion: "CEFR C1 • DEFENDING IN Q&A"
                titulo: "Tactful Responses to Difficult Questions"
                puntos:
                  - "Validating the question: 'That is a compelling point...', 'Thank you for raising that crucial aspect.'"
                  - "Buying time to formulate: 'If I understand your query correctly, you are asking whether...'"
                  - "Conceding gracefully: 'That limitation is acknowledged; we plan to address it in future iterations.'"
                  - "Diplomatic disagreement: 'While I see the merit of that approach, our simulations suggest...'"
              - numero: 5
                seccion: "CEFR C1 • CONFERENCING SIMULATION"
                titulo: "Elevator Pitch & IEEE Closing"
                puntos:
                  - "Pitch: 'Our framework enables sub-second optimal dispatch of hybrid microgrids, reducing curtailment by 34%.'"
                  - "Closing: 'Thank you for your time and attention. I would be delighted to take any questions or comments.'"
                  - "Maintains poise, academic integrity, and professional executive presence."
          - numero_tema: 16
            corte: 1
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            titulo: "Heat Transfer Modes (Conduction, Convection & Radiation)"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar en inglés las ecuaciones constitutivas de Fourier, enfriamiento de Newton y radiación de Stefan-Boltzmann."
            concepto_clave_latex: "q''_x = -k\\frac{dT}{dx} \\quad ; \\quad q'' = h(T_s - T_\\infty) \\quad ; \\quad E_b = \\varepsilon \\sigma T_s^4"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• q''_x = -k dT/dx -> \"heat flux q double prime sub x (in watts per square meter) equals minus thermal conductivity k times d T by d x\" (note: q = heat rate [W], q' = per unit length [W/m], q'' = heat flux [W/m²], q''' = volumetric generation [W/m³]!).\n• q'' = h (T_s - T_∞) -> \"convective heat flux equals convection coefficient h times surface temperature T sub s minus free-stream temperature T infinity\".\n• E_b = ε σ T_s⁴ -> \"emissive power equals emissivity epsilon times the Stefan-Boltzmann constant sigma times absolute surface temperature T sub s to the fourth power\"."
            ejemplo: "Exposición oral de disipación térmica combinada por convección y radiación en la cubierta posterior de un panel solar."
            bloque_sugerido: "Heat Transfer Speech 35 min • Primes on heat flux (q, q', q'', q''') & T-infinity"
          - numero_tema: 17
            corte: 1
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            titulo: "Solar Photovoltaic & Wind Power Equations"
            objetivo: "Exponer con fluidez la potencia eólica, el coeficiente de Betz, el factor de llenado fotovoltaico (FF) y la eficiencia STC."
            concepto_clave_latex: "P_w = \\frac{1}{2} C_p \\rho A v^3 \\quad ; \\quad FF = \\frac{V_{\\text{mp}} I_{\\text{mp}}}{V_{\\text{oc}} I_{\\text{sc}}} \\quad ; \\quad \\eta_{\\text{PV}} = \\frac{V_{\\text{oc}} I_{\\text{sc}} FF}{G \\cdot A_c}"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• P_w = 1/2 C_p ρ A v³ -> \"extracted wind power P sub w equals one-half times power coefficient C sub p times air density rho times rotor swept area A times wind speed v cubed\" (Betz limit: C_p,max = 16/27 ≈ 0.593).\n• FF = (V_mp I_mp) / (V_oc I_sc) -> \"fill factor F-F equals V at maximum power times I at maximum power, divided by open-circuit voltage V sub o c times short-circuit current I sub s c\"."
            ejemplo: "Defensa técnica en inglés del impacto cúbico de la velocidad del viento en parques eólicos de La Guajira."
            bloque_sugerido: "Renewables Keynote 35 min • Betz power equation & PV I-V curve metrics aloud"
          - numero_tema: 18
            corte: 2
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            titulo: "Power Systems & Optimal Power Flow (OPF) Notation"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar potencia compleja, ecuaciones no lineales de flujo de carga AC y magnitudes en el sistema por unidad (p.u.)."
            concepto_clave_latex: "S = P + jQ \\quad ; \\quad P_i = \\sum_{k=1}^{N} |V_i||V_k|(G_{ik}\\cos\\theta_{ik} + B_{ik}\\sin\\theta_{ik}) \\quad ; \\quad X_{\\text{p.u.}} = \\frac{X_{\\text{actual}}}{X_{\\text{base}}}"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• S = P + jQ -> \"apparent (complex) power S equals active power P (in megawatts) plus j times reactive power Q (in megavars)\".\n• P_i = Σ_{k=1}^N |V_i||V_k| (G_ik cos θ_ik + B_ik sin θ_ik) -> \"active power injection at bus i equals the sum from k equals one to N of voltage magnitude V sub i times V sub k times quantity conductance G sub i k cosine theta sub i k plus susceptance B sub i k sine theta sub i k\".\n• p.u. -> \"per-unit value equals actual quantity divided by base quantity\" (e.g., \"one point zero two per unit\")."
            ejemplo: "Presentación oral de restricciones nodales de despacho óptimo (AC-OPF) en un alimentador IEEE de 14 nodos."
            bloque_sugerido: "Power Systems Talk 35 min • AC power-flow equations & per-unit verbalization"
          - numero_tema: 19
            corte: 2
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            titulo: "Electrochemistry, Green Hydrogen & Storage Metrics"
            objetivo: "Leer en inglés la ecuación electroquímica de Nernst, estado de carga (SoC) y costo nivelado de energía (LCOE)."
            concepto_clave_latex: "E = E^\\circ - \\frac{RT}{nF}\\ln(Q) \\quad ; \\quad SoC(t) = SoC_0 - \\frac{1}{C_{\\text{nom}}}\\int_0^t I(\\tau)\\,d\\tau \\quad ; \\quad LCOE = \\frac{\\sum_{t=1}^{n}\\frac{I_t + M_t}{(1+r)^t}}{\\sum_{t=1}^{n}\\frac{E_t}{(1+r)^t}}"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• E = E° - (RT / nF) ln(Q) -> \"cell potential E equals standard electrode potential E naught (or E standard) minus R T over n F times the natural log of reaction quotient Q\".\n• SoC(t) -> \"state of charge at time t equals initial state of charge minus one over nominal capacity C nom times the integral from zero to t of current I of tau d tau\".\n• LCOE -> \"levelized cost of energy (in dollars per megawatt-hour) equals discounted life-cycle CAPEX plus O-and-M costs divided by discounted lifetime energy generation at discount rate r\"."
            ejemplo: "Evaluación tecnoeconómica oral de un electrolizador PEM acoplado a baterías LFP expresando LCOE y LCOH en inglés."
            bloque_sugerido: "Storage & H2 Defense 35 min • Nernst potential, Coulomb counting & LCOE formula"
          - numero_tema: 20
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            titulo: "Interpreting & Presenting Graphs, Error Bars & Regression (R^2, RMSE)"
            objetivo: "Exponer oralmente pendientes, barras de incertidumbre, desviación estándar, coeficiente R² y error cuadrático medio (RMSE)."
            concepto_clave_latex: "m = \\frac{\\Delta y}{\\Delta x} \\quad ; \\quad \\sigma = \\sqrt{\\frac{1}{N}\\sum_{i=1}^{N}(x_i - \\mu)^2} \\quad ; \\quad R^2 = 1 - \\frac{SS_{\\text{res}}}{SS_{\\text{tot}}} \\quad ; \\quad \\text{RMSE} = \\sqrt{\\frac{1}{N}\\sum_{i=1}^{N}(y_i - \\hat{y}_i)^2}"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• m = Δy / Δx -> \"the slope m equals delta y over delta x (change in y per unit change in x)\".\n• σ = √[ (1/N) Σ (x_i - μ)² ] -> \"standard deviation sigma equals the square root of one over N times the sum of x sub i minus mean mu, quantity squared\" (error bars: \"mean plus or minus one standard deviation, μ ± σ\").\n• R² -> \"coefficient of determination R-squared\"  |  RMSE (ŷ_i = \"y-hat sub i\") -> \"root-mean-square error equals the square root of the mean of squared residuals y sub i minus y-hat sub i\"."
            ejemplo: "Defensa de validación de un modelo de predicción solar con R² = 0.984 ('R-squared of zero point nine eight four') y barras de error."
            bloque_sugerido: "Regression & Stats Talk 35 min • Describing R-squared, y-hat, RMSE & error bars"
          - numero_tema: 21
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            titulo: "Uncertainty Propagation & Optimization Problem Verbalization"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar formulaciones de optimización con restricciones y propagación gaussiana de incertidumbre experimental."
            concepto_clave_latex: "\\min_{x \\in \\mathbb{R}^n} f(x) \\;\\;\\text{s.t.}\\;\\; g_i(x) \\le 0,\\; h_j(x) = 0 \\quad ; \\quad u_y = \\sqrt{\\sum_{k=1}^{m}\\left(\\frac{\\partial y}{\\partial x_k} u_{x_k}\\right)^2}"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• min_{x ∈ ℝ^n} f(x) s.t. g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0 -> \"minimize objective function f of x over x in R-n, subject to inequality constraints g sub i of x less than or equal to zero and equality constraints h sub j of x equal to zero\".\n• u_y = √[ Σ (∂y/∂x_k · u_{x_k})² ] -> \"combined standard uncertainty u sub y equals the square root of the sum of squared sensitivity coefficients partial y over partial x sub k times uncertainty u sub x k\"."
            ejemplo: "Exposición formal en congreso IEEE de un problema de dimensionamiento óptimo sujeto a restricciones operativas e incertidumbre."
            bloque_sugerido: "Conference Defense 35 min • 'Minimize... subject to...' & GUM uncertainty aloud"
          - numero_tema: 22
            corte: 2
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• Ma = v / c -> \"Mach number Ma equals flow velocity v divided by speed of sound c\".
• T_0 / T = 1 + ((γ - 1)/2) Ma² -> \"stagnation temperature T naught over static temperature T equals one plus quantity gamma minus one over two times Mach number squared\".
• P_0 / P = (1 + ((γ - 1)/2) Ma²)^(γ/(γ - 1)) -> \"total pressure P naught over static pressure P equals quantity one plus gamma minus one over two times Mach squared, all raised to the power of gamma over gamma minus one\"."
            titulo: "Compressible Gas Dynamics & Isentropic Flow Notation"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar en inglés el número de Mach, relaciones de estancamiento isentrópico y el flujo másico crítico en toberas de turbinas de gas."
            concepto_clave_latex: "Ma = \\frac{v}{c} \\quad ; \\quad \\frac{T_0}{T} = 1 + \\frac{\\gamma - 1}{2} Ma^2 \\quad ; \\quad \\frac{P_0}{P} = \\left( 1 + \\frac{\\gamma - 1}{2} Ma^2 \\right)^{\\frac{\\gamma}{\\gamma - 1}}"
            ejemplo: "Exposición oral del comportamiento supersónico en la tobera de una turbina de expansión criogénica para licuefacción de gas natural."
            bloque_sugerido: "Gas Dynamics Speech 35 min • Stagnation pressure, speed of sound & Mach verbalization"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "Compressible Aerodynamics Symbols"
                puntos:
                  - "Mach number (Ma or M): Subsonic (Ma < 1), Transonic (0.8 < Ma < 1.2), Supersonic (Ma > 1)."
                  - "Stagnation or total states are indexed with subscript zero (T_0: 'T naught' or 'T zero')."
                  - "Specific heat ratio gamma (gamma = c_p / c_v, typically 1.4 for air and 1.3 for natural gas)."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Nozzle Choking & Shock Waves"
                puntos:
                  - "Pronounce: 'When back pressure drops below critical pressure ratio P-star over P-naught, the throat chokes at Mach one.'"
                  - "Pronounce: 'Normal shock wave entails an abrupt entropy increase with supersonic deceleration.'"
          - numero_tema: 23
            corte: 2
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• ρ (∂u/∂t + u · ∇u) = -∇p + μ ∇²u + ρ g -> \"fluid density rho times open parenthesis partial u by partial t plus velocity vector u dot del u close parenthesis equals minus gradient of pressure del p plus dynamic viscosity mu times laplacian of u del-squared u plus rho times gravity vector g\".
• δ(x) ≈ 5.0 x / √(Re_x) -> \"laminar boundary layer thickness delta of x equals approximately five point zero times distance x divided by the square root of Reynolds number sub x\"."
            titulo: "Navier-Stokes Equations & Boundary Layer Theory Notation"
            objetivo: "Exponer oralmente en inglés la ecuación vectorial de cantidad de movimiento de Navier-Stokes y los parámetros de capa límite de Prandtl."
            concepto_clave_latex: "\\rho \\left( \\frac{\\partial \\mathbf{u}}{\\partial t} + \\mathbf{u} \\cdot \\nabla \\mathbf{u} \\right) = -\\nabla p + \\mu \\nabla^2 \\mathbf{u} + \\rho \\mathbf{g} \\quad ; \\quad \\delta(x) \\approx \\frac{5.0 x}{\\sqrt{Re_x}}"
            ejemplo: "Presentación formal de la simulación CFD de desprendimiento de capa límite en el extradós del álabe de una turbina eólica marina."
            bloque_sugerido: "Fluid Dynamics Keynote 35 min • Navier-Stokes vector operators & Prandtl boundary layer"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "Vector Differential Operators in Fluid Mechanics"
                puntos:
                  - "Nabla / Del (nabla or nabla-squared): 'grad p' (gradient), 'div u' (divergence), 'laplacian u'."
                  - "Advective acceleration term (u · ∇u): 'u dot grad u' represents non-linear convective inertia."
                  - "Viscous diffusion term: mu times del-squared u accounts for internal shear dissipation."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Boundary Layer Metrics"
                puntos:
                  - "Displacement thickness delta-star: 'delta star equals integral from zero to infinity of one minus u over U-infinity d y'."
                  - "Momentum thickness theta: 'momentum thickness theta quantifies the loss of momentum flux across the boundary layer.'"
          - numero_tema: 24
            corte: 2
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• F_{12} -> \"view factor F one-two equals one over area A one times the double integral over A one and A two of cosine theta one times cosine theta two divided by pi times distance S squared d A one d A two\" (Reciprocity: \"A one times F one-two equals A two times F two-one\").
• q_{12} -> \"net radiative exchange q one-two equals sigma times difference T one to the fourth minus T two to the fourth, divided by the sum of surface and geometric radiative resistances\"."
            titulo: "Radiative Heat Transfer, View Factors & Stefan-Boltzmann Enclosures"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar en inglés factores de visión radiativa F_ij, radiosidad J, irradiación G y transferencia neta en recintos grises."
            concepto_clave_latex: "F_{12} = \\frac{1}{A_1} \\int_{A_1} \\int_{A_2} \\frac{\\cos\\theta_1 \\cos\\theta_2}{\\pi S^2} dA_1 dA_2 \\quad ; \\quad q_{12} = \\frac{\\sigma(T_1^4 - T_2^4)}{\\frac{1-\\varepsilon_1}{\\varepsilon_1 A_1} + \\frac{1}{A_1 F_{12}} + \\frac{1-\\varepsilon_2}{\\varepsilon_2 A_2}}"
            ejemplo: "Exposición del balance térmico radiativo en la cámara de combustión de una caldera de biomasa con paredes de agua tubulares."
            bloque_sugerido: "Radiation Exchange Talk 35 min • View factors, reciprocity rule & surface network resistance"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "Radiation Network Analogy"
                puntos:
                  - "Surface resistance: (1 - epsilon) / (epsilon * A), verbalized as 'one minus emissivity over emissivity times area'."
                  - "Space (geometric) resistance: 1 / (A_1 * F_12), verbalized as 'one over A one times view factor F one-two'."
                  - "Summation rule in enclosures: 'the sum of view factors F sub i j over all enclosing surfaces j equals one'."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Radiosity and Irradiation"
                puntos:
                  - "Irradiation G: 'total incident radiation flux G in watts per square meter'."
                  - "Radiosity J: 'total radiation flux leaving a surface J equals emitted plus reflected flux'."
          - numero_tema: 25
            corte: 2
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• Bi = h L_c / k -> \"Biot number Bi equals convection coefficient h times characteristic length L sub c divided by thermal conductivity k\" (validity: \"Bi less than zero point one justifies lumped capacitance\").
• (T(t) - T_∞)/(T_i - T_∞) = exp(-t / τ) -> \"dimensionless temperature ratio theta over theta-initial equals exponential of minus time t over thermal time constant tau\".
• Fo = α t / L_c² -> \"Fourier number Fo equals thermal diffusivity alpha times time t divided by characteristic length squared\"."
            titulo: "Transient Heat Conduction: Biot and Fourier Numbers Notation"
            objetivo: "Exponer en inglés el análisis de capacidad concentrada (Lumped Capacitance), número de Biot y número de Fourier en enfriamiento transitorio."
            concepto_clave_latex: "Bi = \\frac{h L_c}{k} < 0.1 \\quad ; \\quad \\frac{T(t) - T_\\infty}{T_i - T_\\infty} = \\exp\\left( -\\frac{t}{\\tau_t} \\right) \\quad ; \\quad \\tau_t = \\frac{\\rho V c_p}{h A_s} \\quad ; \\quad Fo = \\frac{\\alpha t}{L_c^2}"
            ejemplo: "Defensa técnica del enfriamiento térmico de cilindros de almacenamiento de hidrógeno presurizado durante ciclos de llenado rápido."
            bloque_sugerido: "Transient Thermal Defense 35 min • Biot number validity, thermal time constant & Fourier number"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "Dimensionless Thermal Numbers"
                puntos:
                  - "Biot number (Bi): Ratio of internal conduction resistance to external convection resistance."
                  - "Fourier number (Fo): Dimensionless time measuring the degree of thermal penetration into a solid."
                  - "Characteristic length L_c: Volume divided by surface area (V / A_s)."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Lumped System Decay"
                puntos:
                  - "Pronounce: 'When Biot number is below zero point one, temperature gradients inside the body are negligible.'"
                  - "Pronounce: 'The thermal time constant tau equals rho times volume times specific heat divided by h times surface area.'"
          - numero_tema: 26
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• [v_d, v_q, v_0]^T = P(θ) [v_a, v_b, v_c]^T -> \"the direct, quadrature, and zero-sequence voltage vector v d-q-zero equals two-thirds times the Park transformation matrix of electrical rotor angle theta times three-phase voltage vector v a-b-c\".
• Direct axis d: \"aligns with the rotor magnetic flux path (field excitation)\".
• Quadrature axis q: \"leads the direct axis by ninety electrical degrees (torque-producing component)\"."
            titulo: "Park dq0 Transformation in Synchronous Machines & Inverter Control"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar en inglés la matriz de transformación d-q-0 de Park para el control vectorial por orientación de campo (FOC) de generadores síncronos e inversores."
            concepto_clave_latex: "\\begin{bmatrix} v_d \\\\ v_q \\\\ v_0 \\end{bmatrix} = \\frac{2}{3} \\begin{bmatrix} \\cos\\theta & \\cos(\\theta - \\frac{2\\pi}{3}) & \\cos(\\theta + \\frac{2\\pi}{3}) \\\\ -\\sin\\theta & -\\sin(\\theta - \\frac{2\\pi}{3}) & -\\sin(\\theta + \\frac{2\\pi}{3}) \\\\ \\frac{1}{2} & \\frac{1}{2} & \\frac{1}{2} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} v_a \\\\ v_b \\\\ v_c \\end{bmatrix}"
            ejemplo: "Presentación del lazo de control de corriente desacoplada id-iq en el convertidor del rotor de una turbina eólica DFIG."
            bloque_sugerido: "Park Transform Speech 35 min • Direct and quadrature axes, rotating frame & angle theta"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "Rotating Reference Frame Concept"
                puntos:
                  - "Converts three-phase AC sinusoidal quantities (stationary a-b-c frame) into two DC quantities (synchronously rotating d-q frame)."
                  - "Enables classical PI controllers to achieve zero steady-state error without requiring complex resonant PR controllers."
                  - "Direct-axis current i_d controls reactive power or flux; quadrature-axis current i_q controls active power or torque."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) Locking"
                puntos:
                  - "Pronounce: 'The phase-locked loop aligns the direct axis with the grid voltage vector by driving v-q to zero.'"
                  - "Pronounce: 'Decoupling feedforward terms eliminate cross-coupling between the d-axis and q-axis current loops.'"
          - numero_tema: 27
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• THD_V = (√(Σ V_h²)) / V_1 * 100% -> \"total harmonic voltage distortion T-H-D sub V equals the square root of the sum of harmonic voltages V sub h squared from h equals two to infinity, divided by fundamental voltage V sub one, expressed as a percentage\".
• S = √(P² + Q_1² + D²) -> \"total apparent power S equals the square root of active power P squared plus fundamental reactive power Q one squared plus distortion power D squared\".
• PF = (1 / √(1 + THD_I²)) cos φ_1 -> \"true power factor equals distortion factor times displacement power factor cosine phi one\"."
            titulo: "Power Quality: Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) & Distortion Power (IEEE 519)"
            objetivo: "Exponer oralmente en inglés la distorsión armónica total de tensión y corriente (THD_v, THD_i), factor de potencia de desplazamiento y potencia aparente de Budeanu."
            concepto_clave_latex: "\\text{THD}_V = \\frac{\\sqrt{\\sum_{h=2}^{\\infty} V_h^2}}{V_1} \\times 100\\% \\quad ; \\quad S = \\sqrt{P^2 + Q_1^2 + D^2} \\quad ; \\quad PF = \\frac{P}{S} = \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\text{THD}_I^2}} \\cos\\phi_1"
            ejemplo: "Defensa de cumplimiento de la norma IEEE 519 en el punto de acoplamiento común (PCC) de una planta de carga de autobuses eléctricos."
            bloque_sugerido: "Harmonics & IEEE 519 Defense 35 min • Verbalizing THD, distortion power D & true power factor"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "IEEE 519 Harmonic Terminology"
                puntos:
                  - "Fundamental frequency component (subscript 1): 60 Hz in Colombia/USA, 50 Hz in Europe."
                  - "Harmonic order h: integer multiple of the fundamental (e.g., 5th harmonic = 300 Hz)."
                  - "Total Demand Distortion (TDD): THD normalized against maximum demand load current rather than instantaneous current."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "True Power Factor vs Displacement"
                puntos:
                  - "Pronounce: 'Displacement power factor is cosine phi one; true power factor incorporates harmonic current distortion.'"
                  - "Pronounce: 'Active power filters inject anti-phase harmonic currents to cancel non-linear load distortion.'"
          - numero_tema: 28
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• V_cell = E_Nernst - η_act - η_ohmic - η_conc -> \"cell operating voltage equals Nernst thermodynamic reversible potential minus activation overpotential eta act minus ohmic loss eta ohmic minus mass-transport concentration overpotential eta conc\".
• η_act = (RT / αF) ln(j / j_0) -> \"activation overpotential equals R T over transfer coefficient alpha times Faraday constant F times the natural logarithm of current density j over exchange current density j naught (Tafel slope)\".
• η_ohmic = j * R_ohm -> \"ohmic overpotential equals current density j in amps per square centimeter times area-specific ionic resistance R ohm\"."
            titulo: "Fuel Cell Polarization Curve & Butler-Volmer Overpotential Notation"
            objetivo: "Exponer en inglés la curva de polarización de celdas de combustible PEM/SOFC, sobrepotenciales de activación (Tafel), óhmicos y de concentración."
            concepto_clave_latex: "V_{\\text{cell}} = E_{\\text{Nernst}} - \\eta_{\\text{act}} - \\eta_{\\text{ohmic}} - \\eta_{\\text{conc}} \\quad ; \\quad \\eta_{\\text{act}} = \\frac{RT}{\\alpha F} \\ln\\left(\\frac{j}{j_0}\\right) \\quad ; \\quad \\eta_{\\text{ohmic}} = j \\cdot R_{\\text{ohm}}"
            ejemplo: "Exposición oral del ajuste paramétrico de la curva de polarización experimental de una celda de combustible PEM de automoción."
            bloque_sugerido: "Fuel Cell Polarization Talk 35 min • Butler-Volmer kinetics, Tafel slope & mass-transport limit"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "The Three Loss Regimes of Polarization"
                puntos:
                  - "Low current density: Activation losses dominate due to sluggish oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) kinetics."
                  - "Intermediate current density: Linear slope dominated by ohmic resistance in the proton exchange membrane."
                  - "High current density: Sharp drop dominated by mass-transport limitation and reactant starvation."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Electrochemical Kinetics Terminology"
                puntos:
                  - "Exchange current density j_0: 'exchange current density j naught reflects the intrinsic electrocatalytic activity'."
                  - "Faraday constant F: 'Faraday constant F equals ninety-six thousand four hundred eighty-five coulombs per mole'."
          - numero_tema: 29
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• ΔGHG = E_gen * (EF_grid,marg - EF_tech) -> \"net greenhouse gas abatement delta G-H-G equals annual energy generation E gen times open parenthesis marginal grid emission factor minus project technology emission factor close parenthesis\".
• CPBT = GHG_embodied / ΔGHG_annual -> \"carbon payback time C-P-B-T equals total embodied manufacturing emissions in tons of CO2 equivalent divided by annual avoided emissions delta G-H-G annual\"."
            titulo: "Life-Cycle Carbon Accounting & Avoided Emissions Notation"
            objetivo: "Verbalizar en inglés factores de reducción neta de GEI, factor marginal de red, amortización de carbono (CPBT) y créditos de carbono."
            concepto_clave_latex: "\\Delta \\text{GHG} = E_{\\text{gen}} \\cdot (\\text{EF}_{\\text{grid,marg}} - \\text{EF}_{\\text{tech}}) \\quad ; \\quad \\text{CPBT} = \\frac{\\text{GHG}_{\\text{embodied}}}{\\Delta \\text{GHG}_{\\text{annual}}} \\quad [\\text{years}]"
            ejemplo: "Defensa de la certificación de bonos de carbono de un parque solar fotovoltaico de 150 MW ante la metodología ACM0002 de Naciones Unidas."
            bloque_sugerido: "Carbon Accounting Defense 35 min • Marginal emission factor, embodied carbon & CPBT verbalization"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "Carbon Metrics & Accounting Standards"
                puntos:
                  - "Embodied carbon: 'cradle-to-gate greenhouse gas emissions associated with materials and manufacturing'."
                  - "Carbon payback time (CPBT): 'the time required for a renewable asset to offset its own embodied footprint'."
                  - "Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions: 'direct operational, indirect electricity purchases, and upstream value chain emissions'."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Marginal Abatement Cost Curve (MACC)"
                puntos:
                  - "Pronounce: 'Marginal abatement cost equals annualized project net cost divided by metric tons of CO2 mitigated per year.'"
                  - "Negative abatement cost indicates net-positive economic return through energy efficiency."
          - numero_tema: 30
            corte: 3
            modalidad: "notacion_ingenieria"
            verbalizacion_ingles: "• r_ij = x_ij / √(Σ x_kj²) -> \"normalized decision element r sub i j equals actual value x sub i j divided by the square root of the sum of squared criteria values x sub k j from k equals one to m\".
• S_i^+ = √(Σ (v_ij - v_j+)²) -> \"Euclidean separation distance S sub i plus equals the square root of the sum over all criteria j of weighted value v sub i j minus positive ideal value v sub j plus, quantity squared\".
• C_i* = S_i- / (S_i+ + S_i-) -> \"relative closeness coefficient C sub i star equals separation from negative-ideal solution divided by the sum of separations from positive-ideal and negative-ideal solutions\"."
            titulo: "Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) & TOPSIS Optimization Notation"
            objetivo: "Exponer en inglés matrices de decisión normalizadas, distancias euclidianas euclidianas a la solución ideal y coeficiente de proximidad relativa (TOPSIS)."
            concepto_clave_latex: "r_{ij} = \\frac{x_{ij}}{\\sqrt{\\sum_{k=1}^m x_{kj}^2}} \\quad ; \\quad S_i^+ = \\sqrt{\\sum_{j=1}^n (v_{ij} - v_j^+)^2} \\quad ; \\quad C_i^* = \\frac{S_i^-}{S_i^+ + S_i^-}"
            ejemplo: "Defensa de la selección óptima de emplazamiento de un parque eólico marino en Colombia utilizando el algoritmo TOPSIS ponderado por AHP."
            bloque_sugerido: "MCDM Keynote 35 min • TOPSIS algorithm, ideal solution distance & closeness coefficient"
            slides:
              - numero: 1
                seccion: "NOTATION IN ENGLISH"
                titulo: "MCDM Multi-Criteria Optimization Symbols"
                puntos:
                  - "Decision matrix X: Alternatives along rows (i = 1...m) and evaluation criteria along columns (j = 1...n)."
                  - "Criteria weights w_j: Must satisfy the sum of w_j equals one (derived via Analytic Hierarchy Process - AHP)."
                  - "Positive-ideal solution A-plus maximizes benefit criteria and minimizes cost criteria."
              - numero: 2
                seccion: "VERBALIZATION DRILL"
                titulo: "Ranking Alternatives Out Loud"
                puntos:
                  - "Pronounce: 'Alternative i is ranked according to its closeness coefficient C sub i star; the option closest to one represents the optimal compromise.'"
                  - "Culmination of the English for Engineering sequence at Universidad del Magdalena."
      - codigo: "04021823"
        nombre: "Ingeniería del Diseño y Modelado en 3D"
        creditos: 3
        obligatoria: true

        temas:

            corte: 1
            modalidad: "tecnica"

            concepto_clave_latex: "E = \\frac{D_{\\text{dibujo}}}{D_{\\text{real}}} \\quad ; \\quad \\theta_{\\text{diedro}} = 90^\\circ"
            ejemplo: "Lectura e interpretación de planos constructivos de una carcasa de turbina."

            concepto_clave_latex: "\\text{GDL} = 6(N - 1) - \\sum_{i} c_i"
            ejemplo: "Ensamblaje completo de un seguidor solar de dos ejes con actuador lineal."

            objetivo: "Especificar ajustes eje-agujero y tolerancias geométricas para manufacturabilidad."
            concepto_clave_latex: "T = D_{\\max} - D_{\\min} \\quad ; \\quad J = D_{\\text{agujero}} - d_{\\text{eje}}"
            ejemplo: "Tolerancia de concentricidad y ajuste de rodamiento en el eje de un generador."

            ejemplo: "Diseño estructural resistente a ráfagas de viento de 120 km/h para mesas PV."

            concepto_clave_latex: "[K]\\vec{u} = \\vec{F} \\quad ; \\quad \\sigma_{\\text{vM}} = \\sqrt{\\sigma_1^2 - \\sigma_1\\sigma_2 + \\sigma_2^2} \\le \\frac{S_y}{FS}"
            ejemplo: "Simulación estructural FEA del soporte de góndola verificando factor de seguridad."
            bloque_sugerido: "Laboratorio CAE 50 min • Esfuerzos Von Mises"
          - numero_tema: 7

            objetivo: "Evaluar disipación de calor en aletas y caída de presión interna mediante mallas 3D."
            concepto_clave_latex: "\\nabla\\cdot(k\\nabla T) + \\dot{q}_{\\text{gen}} = 0"
            ejemplo: "Optimización geométrica de un disipador de aluminio para módulos IGBT."

            concepto_clave_latex: "m_{\\text{BOM}} = \\sum_{k=1}^N \\rho_k V_k \\quad ; \\quad \\Delta m \\le 0.01\\,m"
            ejemplo: "Paquete técnico completo y prototipo impreso en 3D de un rodete microhidráulico."
